reviewNotes: GPT-6 AI editorial review of 34 original low-typing questions: complete German sentences, noun inflections, all offered distractors, accepted answers, bilingual explanations, hints and distinct scenarios reviewed. Seventeen source rows authored; three deferred for basic level, ambiguous document type or specialist legal scope. Distinguished Arbeitslosenquote (percentage) from Arbeitslosenzahl (absolute count), and corrected inherited mistranslation of the latter. Benefits and work authorization contexts avoid universal eligibility claims. All source CEFR labels unverified. Structural CI does not establish independent linguistic approval, rights clearance, certification or transfer. Targets pending and publicationApproved=false.
